== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata)]] (<code>2220_1121</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 121), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-121-Evacuation_Control.png]]) shows the original text of [[Evacuation Control (V)]], and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-evacuationcontrol-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E2 text of [[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed. Also in Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), p. A-7 ([[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf]]).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_121</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip mark E as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-121-Evacuation_Control-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
